content: KAUN-O ketin mahsanih, “Kowe, nein aramas, ale ehu kedlahs keng oh sehkasang omw alis kan oh pitenmoangomw koaros. Kowe eri tenekihda pohn mehn tenek oh nehkpeseng ni mwutumwut siluh.

Ke pahn isikala kesiluhn mwutumwuto nan kahnimwo ni ahnsou me mwekid en mahwen me ke wiewiao pahn imwisekla. Pil ale ehu mwutumwuto oh pelehkipene noumw kedlahso nindokon omw pahn alialuseli likin kahnimwo. Mwutumwut me luhweo ke pahn kamwerepeseng nan kisinieng, I ahpw pahn pwakiheki nei kedlahset.
Ke pahn nekidala ekis pitenmoang oh kidimpene nan pwungipen omw likou kan.
Mwuhr ke pahn ale ekei oh keselahng nan kisiniei, oh mweidohng en mwasikala. Eri, sang wasao kisiniei pahn kohda oh isikala wehin Israel pwon.”
KAUN-O, Wasa Lapalahpie ahpw mahsanih, “Kilang Serusalem. I kihdiong nanwerengen sampah, wehi teikan ahpw kapilpene.

Ahpw Serusalem kahngohdiong ei koasoandi kan oh kasalehda me e suwed sang wehi teikan, sapeik sang wehi teikan me kapilpene. Serusalem soikala ei koasoandi kan oh sohte men kapwaiada ei kosonned akan.

Eri met, rong kowe Serusalem, rong dahme ngehi, KAUN-O, Wasa Lapalahpie, ketin mahmahsanih. Pwehki omw sohte peikiong ei kosonned kan oh sohte kapwaiada ei koasoandi kan, ke wiadahr me suwed sang wehi teikan me kapiluhkpene. Ke idawehnlahr tiahk en wehi teikan.
Eri, ngehi, KAUN-O, Wasa Lapalahpie, mahsanihong uhk me kowe iei ei imwintihti. I pahn kadeikuhkada wasa me wehi koaros kak kilang.
Pwehki mehkoaros me ke wiadahr me I kin kalahdeki, I pahn kaloke Serusalem laudsang ei kalokeier mahs oh sohte ehu kalokolok en mwuhr pahn duwe met.
Pwehki met, sahm oh ihn kan nan Serusalem pahn kangala neirail seri kan, oh seri kan pahn kangala samarail oh inarail kan. I pahn kalokei kumwail oh kamwarakpeseng wasa koaros irail kan me momourte.

“Iei me kahrehda ngehi Koht ieias—met iei mahsen en KAUN-O, Wasa Lapalahpie—pwehki amwail kasaminehkihla Tehnpasei Sarawio me suwed, oh tiahk saut kan me kumwail wiadahr, I pahn kauweikumwailla ni sohte kupwur mahk.
Silikis ehun aramas akan pahn mehkihla soumwahu oh duhpek nan kahnimwo; a silikis ehu pahn mehkihla kedlahs likin kahnimwo; oh I pahn kamarakpeseng luhwe kan nan kisinieng oh pwakihkin irail kedlahs.
“Ke pahn kehn engin ei engieng lao I nsenamwahula. Ni mepwukat eh pahn pweida, ke pahn esehla me ngehi, KAUN-O, me mahsenionguhkehr, pwehki ei engiengkidahr omw soaloalopwoat.
Aramas koaros sang nan wehi kan me kapiluhkpene pahn keid wasaht oh kouruhrkin uhk oh sohte pahn men keidohng mpomw.
“Ni ei kin engiengda pahmw oh kalokeiuk, wehi koaros me kapiluhkpene pahn kin masepwehkada. Re pahn kin mwamwahlkinuhkala oh kouruhrkin uhk.
I pahn ketikihsang konomw kisin mwenge oh mweidala pwe ke en duhpekla. Ke pahn kehn medek en duhpek rasehng arep keng me pekederdohng kamwomwuhkala.
I pahn kadarodo lehk oh mahn lawalo pwe en kemehla noumw seri kan, iangahki soumwahu, kamaramas, oh mahwen pwe en kemeiukala. Ngehi, KAUN-O, me mahmahsen.”
